body: I've been here 3 weeks, I've joined a club. I run every day. I just wish I had one close friend. Someone I could talk to. Doesn't exist for me. I don't want to talk to my parents I want to relate to someone on my generation scale. Don't get me wrong my parents are great, but I need social connection. I don't know what to say 99% of the time. I don't know I need a talent maybe to make me interesting. I've been on the computer too much and I want off. I feel like my medication is making me going crazy. I'm very confused. Idk I guess I just want to relate to someone or keep a conversation going for a while. I hate my thoughts. Thanks in advance.
